{"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates volatility and fails to capture sharp price spikes (e.g., Example 2, 3, 4 where true outcomes exceed forecasts by 5-10% during high sentiment periods).", "Forecasts exhibit a strong upward bias in the first 7 days of the horizon, failing to account for immediate mean reversion or downward pressure seen in true outcomes.", "Sentiment history (values > 0.20) correlates with higher-than-forecasted volatility; models ignore the risk of sudden reversals following sentiment spikes.", "The model assumes a smooth linear trend, whereas true outcomes show erratic behavior with frequent intrahorizon peaks and troughs that deviate significantly from the forecast path.", "Correction heuristic: Apply a negative bias adjustment to the first 10 days of forecasts (reduce by ~3-5%) and increase volatility parameters when sentiment history shows recent spikes."]
